# `left`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the leftmost `len`(`len` can be string type) characters from the string `str`,if `len` is less or equal than 0 the result is an empty string.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
left(str, len)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- left, example 1
> SELECT left('Spark SQL', 3);
Spa
```

```sql
-- left, example 2
> SELECT left(encode('Spark SQL', 'utf-8'), 3);
Spa
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.3.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
